verdict: DO_NOT_SHIP -- four blockers in the module, reproduced by the author; the exam's gates count any refusal and cannot see a mutant refusing for the wrong reason

blockers.B1_shared_code_object: functions sharing one code object pass for each other: factory closures (check_low/check_high from one _make), and every function behind a decorator without functools.wraps resolves to the same inner code. t01_shared_code.py: 'factory closure: VERDICT PASS' with only check_low called; 'no-wraps decorator: VERDICT PASS' with only entry_a called
blockers.B2_code_equality_not_identity: calls matched with == on code objects, which ignores co_filename and qualname: a vendored copy in another module, a pinned exec'd copy of styxx.protocol (the pattern run_protocol_v5.py itself uses for v4), and two dataclasses' generated __init__ all satisfy each other. t02_code_equality.py, t03_generated.py
blockers.B3_global_section_slot: the open section is one process-wide slot: a thread started in A (or outside any section) that calls while B is open credits B; an asyncio task created in A and run during B credits B. t04_thread_leak_section.py, t10_misc.py (a)
blockers.B4_c_profiler_crash: under cProfile sys.getprofile() is a non-callable Profile object; the hook calls it -> TypeError escapes the harness, and exit reinstalls it so the user's profiler is destroyed. t06_under_cprofile.py

defects.D1_non_lifo_and_reentry: tracers exited out of LIFO order, or one tracer entered twice, leave a hook installed and blind the other; re-entry refuses a correct call. t07_state_leaks.py
defects.D2_resolution_crashes: a declared module raising RuntimeError or SyntaxError at import, or a __wrapped__ loop, escapes as that exception rather than GateSpecError. t08_crashes.py
defects.D3_non_string_trace_keys: coverage_trace.targets with an int/None key crashes score() and check_metrics() with TypeError in sorted(). t08_crashes.py
defects.D4_undisclosed_overblocking: threads existing before the trace, _thread-started threads, parallel sections in two threads, and a harness that calls sys.setprofile/cProfile inside a section are all refused or blinded; only child processes were disclosed. t05_false_refusals.py, t10_misc.py (b)

nits.N1_reserved_keys: 'section' and 'exercises' used as free-text notes scored under v4 and refuse under v5; no committed prereg uses them (G3 honestly 0) but the prereg's 'adds only optional keys' should say they are now reserved
nits.N2_looseness: _TARGET_RE uses $ (matches before a trailing newline); Sub.fit resolves through the MRO to Base.fit so Other().fit() satisfies it; recorded code sha256 values are never checked

exam_audit.reproduced: attempt B reproduces exactly: 24/24, 9/9, G4 refused with reachable x12, G1 not refused with order_stat_bar x1, 86 pairable / 0 disagreements / 53 raised, sha 652dd089, PROCEED_TO_RED_TEAM

False for 6 of 53: those preregs HAVE gates blocks and both versions refuse with 'metric not present in result' -- hand-scored verdicts the protocol cannot reproduce: closed-model-frontier/handedness_accusations_result.json, handedness_v2_result.json, handedness_v3_result.json, range_sanity_report_ab_result.json, frequency-resonance/efficiency_control_result.json, rhythm-rescue/untied_control_result.json. The verdict is unaffected.

defects.D1_g0_counts_any_refusal: frac_violation_mutants_refused counts any GateSpecError; with individual checks deleted from protocol.py, undeclared_section_opened, section_non_string, target_builtin, exercises_not_list, exercises_empty and section_absent still refuse for a later reason. With the non-empty check deleted, an empty 'exercises' beside a declaring gate SCORES PASS and no exam mutant can see it. In the committed run every detail string names the intended reason, so the result is truthful; the gate does not require it.
defects.D2_g2_counts_any_refusal: p1_retro_case_refused is 1.0 on any GateSpecError: misspelling one declared target ('reachabel') refuses at resolution with the P1 harness never run and G2 still passes
defects.D3_valid_cases_insensitive: nested_tracers passes with profiler chaining removed (outer count drops 2->1, unchecked); wraps_decorated passes with inspect.unwrap removed; without unwrap a sibling wraps-decorated function satisfies the declaration and no case covers it
defects.D5_self_coverage_floor_only: one genuine case per section plus fabricated results reaches PROCEED; only coverage_trace (a one-line factory) and _check_coverage are declared
defects.D6_population_overstated: of 86 'pairable', 47 fail at construction before v5's new code runs; v5 reached score() on 39 and produced verdicts on 33. All 33 match their committed verdicts, so a correctly filtered attempt-A G3 would also have passed -- the outcome does not depend on the G3 rewrite
defects.D7_attempt_a_undocumented: no RESULT doc or CHANGELOG entry for attempt A's failure, unlike BC-1/BIN-1; the rename protocol_v5_result.json -> protocol_v5_result_run1.json is unexplained
